title: A consortium of 21 banks, including Bank of America, Citigroup, and Goldman Sachs, says it will establish a company and launch its stablecoin venture in H1 2027 (Gina Heeb/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Gina Heeb / Wall Street Journal: A consortium of 21 banks, including Bank of America, Citigroup, and Goldman Sachs, says it will establish a company and launch its stablecoin venture in H1 2027 — Twenty-one firms, including several megabanks, plan to establish a company that would help guard against competition from digital assets
